sloka: एवमुक्त्वा ततस्तुष्टो रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।ददौ तस्मै शुभं ह्येकं हस्ताभरणमुत्तमम् ।। ६.१०६.२७ ।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tatastuṣṭo rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।dadau tasmai śubhaṁ hyekaṁ hastābharaṇamuttamam ।। 6.106.27 ।।

translations.english: Then, urged by Ravana's words, the charioteer speedily whipped up the horses, and in a moment that great chariot of the rakshasa king stood before Rama at the front of the battle.
